name: Astral Host (Legendary Mesmerist Archetype)
body:
Some mesmerists do not so much connect to the Astral as they are a receptacle for it. An astral host takes in the ideas which mesh with themselves from the sea of endless thoughts to power their magic. To take the astral host archetype, a classic mesmerist must also take a hypnotic focus.

Absorb Quiddity

An astral host can cast any focus spells of their chosen focus, provided that they can cast spells of that level. The rest of their spell selection is extremely limited. At 1st level, an astral host knows two 0th level spells. At every even level thereafter, they learn an additional spell of their choice, which must be of a lower level than the highest level spell they can cast. In addition to resting, an astral host must spend 1 hour each day absorbing stray thoughts to regain their daily allotment of spells. During this period, they cannot partake in any strenuous activity. They are able to do so any time of day, but no more than once every 24 hours. This replaces towering ego and alters the legendary mesmerist’s spellcasting.

Interplanar Lattice (Su)

At 10th level, the astral host’s mind permanently connects to the Silver Sea. A number of times per day equal to their Charisma modifier, they can use the connection to find answers. This functions as contact other plane, except they can only contact the totality of thoughts within the Astral Plane, treating it as a single entity, and deduct their mesmerist level from the result of the percentage roll. In addition, the astral host must choose the nature of their permanent connection to the plane from the following options. Once the choice is made, it cannot be changed.

Apotheosis: The astral host commits themselves as a conduit to the ideas that comprise their hypnotic focus. They gain an additional spell slot at every spell level available to them.
Communion: The astral host opens their mind to the potential of every thought, adapting their own. They gain access to an additional hypnotic focus, as well as its associated bonus feat. This allows them to apply hypnotic focus using its rules and cast its focus spells. An astral host with the madness focus must abide by the rules of that focus at all times.

At 13th, 16th, and 19th level, the astral host gains an additional hypnotic focus. This replaces focus breach for the legendary mesmerist and masterful tricks for the classic mesmerist.
